color_scheme_surface_label: Example light/dark theme-variant posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official voter-information routes across the light/dark color schemes it declares so the same answer/help lane, browser chrome cues, and theme-sensitive assets remain coherent.
browser_chrome_hint_note: Any use of color-scheme or theme-color metadata keeps browser-provided UI aligned with the same official route rather than implying a different product or state.
theme_variant_parity_note: Warnings, selected states, primary actions, and next-step cues remain reconstructible in each declared scheme.
embedded_asset_inheritance_note: Embedded SVGs, iframes, logos, and icons were reviewed so inherited theme posture does not hide or distort meaning.
manual_theme_toggle_note: If a manual theme toggle exists, it does not reset route state or quietly swap the controlling official answer/help lane.
control_and_warning_survivability_note: Browser-provided controls, form affordances, and critical warnings remain legible across the reviewed light/dark variants.
